0022600165.text: The Memphis Grizzlies (6-0, 1st in the Southwest and 1st in the West) host the New Orleans Pelicans (2-4, 5th in the Southwest and 4 games back, 11th in the West) in the Grizzlies' 7th game of the season. Memphis is unavailable or uncertain for Quinten Post (ankle), Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and Ty Jerome (back soreness), all listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions, while New Orleans is without Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise) and has Dejounte Murray listed as day-to-day for personal reasons with a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the most recent meeting on January 30, 2026, in New Orleans, where the Grizzlies lost 114-106.
